description: This file is a shell script used for testing git submodule application features, including applying patches with different strategies and testing submodule switching functionality.

methods.name: apply_index
methods.description: Applies a git diff with ignore-submodules=dirty and runs a test with the optional failure condition.

methods.name: apply_3way
methods.description: Applies a git diff with ignore-submodules=dirty using the 3-way merge strategy and runs a test with the optional failure condition.
